item.title: Broken Hill Mines Signs Agreement with Kingfisher Mining to Share Rasp Processing Plant Capacity
item.description: BHM inks 10-year pact with KFM to process ore at Rasp plant, accelerating production and cutting capex.

item.title: AusQuest Significantly Expands Cangallo Copper-Gold System in Peru
item.description: AusQuest expands Cangallo copper-gold in Peru; near-surface oxide boosts heap-leach potential; 5,000m RC and 5,000m diamond drilling planned.

item.title: Island Pharma Partners with USAMRIID and Geneva Foundation for Galidesivir under FDA Animal Rule
item.description: Island Pharma signs a 3-year CRADA with USAMRIID and Geneva Foundation to fast-track Galidesivir for Marburg under FDA Animal Rule, eyeing NDA.

item.title: Cobalt Blue Advances Kwinana Refinery and Broken Hill Technology Centre
item.description: Cobalt Blue advances Kwinana refinery and BHTC, delivering pCAM samples meeting offtake specs; Hartree Partners signs LOI toward FID and domestic feed options.

item.title: OD6 Metals Flags Strategic US Critical Mineral Acquisition with Equity Placement
item.description: OD6 Metals flags exclusive US fluorspar deal with Quinn project in Nevada; launches A$3.4m equity raise to fund due diligence and exploration.

item.title: Control Bionics Bolsters European Expansion with German Reimbursement for NeuroNode
item.description: Control Bionics (ASX: CBL) secures German reimbursement for NeuroNode, fueling Europe wholesale push and distributor ramp-up amid funding risks.

item.title: Pure Foods Tasmania Sees Positive Cash Flow and Increased Profit Margins After Business Realignment
item.description: ASX: PFT Pure Foods Tasmania posts positive cash flow and rising margins after realignment, with 70% higher Easter orders and expanding retail reach.

item.title: Vintage Energy Extends PURE Loan Facility to Support Southern Flank Reinvigoration
item.description: Vintage Energy extends $10m PURE loan to Jan 2028, enabling Odin-3 and Vali-4 drilling with $5m SA grant; potential early $3m repayment, cash covenant eased.

item.title: The Calmer Co Subsidiary Wins $354,000 Grant to Upgrade Fiji Kava Manufacturing Facility
item.description: The Calmer Co International subsidiary wins $354k Fiji CADP grant to upgrade Navua kava RTD bottling, boost Pacific supply chain and expand production.

item.title: AKORA Resources Granted Mining Permit for Bekisopa Iron Ore Project
item.description: AKORA Resources secures 25-year Bekisopa mining permit in Madagascar, unlocking financing, development, and potential expansion to a 1bn-tonne resource.
